transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been having trouble keeping my mind on things. Driving around for work, every CB chirp or fuel price sign pulls me off track, or I get some new idea in my head. Then I miss stuff I usually wouldn’t, like delivery notes or who I said I’d call back. It’s been going on for months, and it’s starting to cause problems.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless?

Yeah… I guess so. I don’t really sit still much lately. I keep making extra work for myself—messing with route plans, checking up on new guys after hours, fixing stuff at home. If I’m just sitting there, I get kind of antsy.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I don’t know… not more than most people, I guess. I’ll make quick calls sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m doing wild stuff without thinking.
Do you often find yourself making careless mistakes in your work or other activities?

Yeah… more than I’d like. I’ll miss little things at work that I normally wouldn’t, like a delivery note from a client, or I forget who I told I’d call back. My attention just keeps getting pulled off by every little thing.
Do you often find yourself talking a lot more than others in social situations?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ll talk if I need to, but I’m not usually the one taking over a conversation.
Are these difficulties you're experiencing affecting your relationships with family, friends, or coworkers?

Yeah… a bit. At work I’ve had to ask dispatch or clients to repeat things I should’ve kept track of, and I’ve missed a couple sales follow-ups because I was kind of chasing too many things at once.

At home… my wife and daughter notice. Feels like they’re walking on eggshells sometimes, and I know I’m adding stress when I should be helping.
Have you always had trouble with focus and restlessness, or is this something that started more recently?
More recently, I guess. It’s been about seven months… since my daughter moved back home and I’ve been trying to keep everything steady.
Are you having difficulty completing tasks or meeting deadlines at work due to your trouble with focus and restlessness?

Yeah… somewhat. I’m still getting things done, but I’ve had to ask dispatch or clients to repeat details I should’ve kept straight. And a couple sales follow-ups kind of slipped because I was chasing too many things at once. It’s not good.
Have you always had trouble with focus or restlessness, even when you were a kid?
No… not really as a kid. This is more recent — maybe the last seven months or so, since my daughter moved back home and I’ve been trying to keep things steady.
Did you have trouble with focus or restlessness when you were in school?
Not really. In school I don’t remember it being a problem. This has been more like the last seven months, since my daughter came back home and I’ve been trying to keep things steady.
Did you ever get into trouble in school for not being able to sit still or pay attention?
No, I don’t think so. I don’t remember getting in trouble for that back then. This has really just been… more the last seven months, since my daughter moved back home.
Did you have any problems with focus, restlessness, or impulsivity as a child that your parents or teachers noticed?

No, not that I know of. My parents or teachers never really made a thing of it. This has been more… the last seven months or so, since my daughter moved back home and I’ve been trying to keep things steady.
Did your parents ever comment on you being overly restless or having trouble focusing when you were a child?
Not that I can remember. My folks didn’t really say much like that about me as a kid.
Did you experience any of these focus or restlessness issues before your daughter moved back home, like when you were a teenager?

No… not really. I mean, I don’t remember it being a problem when I was a teenager. It’s more been these last seven months or so, since my daughter moved back home and I’ve been trying to keep everything steady.
Did you have any problems with focus or restlessness during childhood that you remember?
I don’t really remember anything like that from when I was a kid. Nothing that stood out, anyway.
Have you noticed these problems with focus and restlessness at home, at work, or in both settings?

Both, I guess. At work I’ve had to ask dispatch or customers to repeat things I should’ve caught the first time, and a couple follow-ups kind of slipped by me. At home… it’s been tense. My wife and daughter seem like they’re walking on eggshells, and I know I’m probably adding to it.
How old were you when you first started noticing these problems with focus and restlessness?
I guess around 49… it’s really just been the last seven months or so, since my daughter moved back home. That’s when I started noticing it.
Have you been experiencing these problems with focus and restlessness consistently over the past seven months, or have there been times when they were better or worse?
It’s been around seven months, yeah. Since my daughter moved back home and I’ve been trying to keep things steady. I don’t know that it’s been exactly the same every day, but it’s been there.
Have you experienced significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other areas of life due to your symptoms?

Yeah… some. At work I’ve had to ask dispatch or clients to repeat details I should’ve gotten the first time, and a couple follow-ups slipped because I was trying to keep track of too many things.

At home, it’s… not great. My wife and daughter seem like they’re walking on eggshells, and I know I’m adding strain when I’m supposed to be helping.
Did you have any problems with focus, restlessness, or impulsivity as an adult before your daughter moved back home?
Not really… not that I noticed much before then. It’s mostly been these past seven months, since my daughter came back home and I’ve been trying to keep everything steady.
